messages:
marcus-eng: @channel Rolling out a new Private feature: self-serve export controls and encrypted audit bundles for VPC/on-prem installs. Goal: customers can generate downloadable, encrypted audit packages and control if/when logs leave their network. Pilot starts next week. :package:

hana-csm: quick ask what's in the bundle? auditors always want specifics.

marcus-eng: bundle contents: config snapshot, access-control lists (redacted secrets), rotation events (timestamps, non-sensitive metadata), and a compact usage timeline. Bundles are encrypted with a tenant-provided public key so we never see plaintext. Admins can set a bundle TTL and whether its exportable off-network.

leah-security: Legal/privacy notes: (1) We added DPA language for encrypted bundles and export controls, (2) bundles are customer-generated and customer-attested, (3) we will not ship raw audit logs offsite unless the admin explicitly toggles export during bundle creation. For FedRAMP/IL5 requests we still require a security engagement.

oliver-ops: Installer note: for air-gapped installs the bundle creation runs locally and writes to the admin-specified path. For VPC installs the Console will offer an encrypted-download flow that returns a signed manifest. No outbound traffic is initiated without explicit admin approval.

marcus-eng: CLI snippets to create a bundle:
```bash
# generate encrypted audit bundle and save locally
redwood private audit bundle create --deployment prod-west --encrypt-with /path/to/pubkey.pem --out /tmp/prod-west-audit.tar.gpg

# create bundle but mark as non-exportable (stays in customer VPC admin console only)
redwood private audit bundle create --deployment prod-west --encrypt-with /path/to/pubkey.pem --exportable false
```
Note: creating a bundle will record an admin audit event.

runbook-bot: Runbook and internal docs: https://redwood.dev/internal/runbooks/private-audit-bundles (internal). Checklist: PKI guidance, admin consent modal, export TTL enforcement.

deploy-bot: Pilot window scheduled: 2026-08-02 02:00-05:00 UTC (invite-only clusters). No service restart expected.

hana-csm: CSMs: suggested short customer blurb?

leah-security: Blurb for CSMs/AEs: "New encrypted audit bundles let you produce auditor-ready artifacts without sharing raw logs. You control the key and export settings. For stricter compliance needs, contact Security for enhanced attestations."

marcus-eng: Timeline:
- Today: internal docs + runbook up for review.
- +7 days: 6-customer pilot (invite).
- +28 days: open beta.
- +60 days: GA pending pilot feedback.

marcus-eng: Action items:
- @oliver-ops: add CI test to verify bundle creation in air-gapped profile (ETA 4 days).
- @leah-security: finalize DPA addendum and 2-sentence legal blurb for Sales (ETA 48h).
- @hana-csm: prepare pilot outreach list and canned emails (ETA 72h).

oliver-ops: Will add CI test and dashboard metric (private.audit.bundle.created).

leah-security: Will draft legal blurb and post to Sales kit.

hana-csm: Will prep pilot list and start outreach.

marcus-eng: Thanks team. DM me if you want early access to the staging console or to be added to the pilot. :raised_hands:
